name: L.L.Bean® Mastercard®
balance_transfer_apr: 19.74%, 25.74% or 30.74%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: one-time, on the llbean.com purchase made in the same visit as instant approval; many exclusions, can't be combined with other offers

verdict.text: Solid 5% at L.L.Bean, but weak elsewhere and store-locked redemption

earn_note: Unlike Macy's, Bloomingdale's, or Wayfair, L.L.Bean has issued this as a single open-loop Mastercard from the start; no separate closed-loop, store-only L.L.Bean card was found. Each Bean Buck equals $1 in savings at L.L.Bean. Bakeries, and cafes inside department stores, grocery stores or warehouse clubs, may earn 1% rather than the 2% restaurant rate. Bean Bucks are forfeited if you go 24 months without a purchase on the card, or if the account closes or falls out of good standing.

redemption_options.method: Applied as savings toward a purchase at L.L.Bean stores, llbean.com or by phone, in any amount

points.per_100k: Not applicable: Bean Bucks accrue and redeem in dollars directly, 1 Bean Buck = $1
points.note: Bean Bucks redeem only on L.L.Bean merchandise and services: no cash, statement credit, or third-party redemption, and not on expedited shipping, oversized freight, sales tax, Outdoor Discovery Programs or L.L.Bean for Business orders. They stay alive as long as you use the card at least once every 24 months.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Bean Bucks redeem only at L.L.Bean.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or L.L.Bean's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or L.L.Bean's public product pages for this card

protection_note: No Guide to Benefits for this card was found, and Citi's pages list no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. Treat it as a rewards card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

services.name: Free shipping at L.L.Bean
services.detail: Free standard U.S. shipping on L.L.Bean orders paid with this card or entirely with Bean Bucks; expedited, oversized, L.L.Bean for Business and international orders are excluded.

services.name: Free return shipping
services.detail: Free return shipping on L.L.Bean orders paid with this card.

services.name: Free monogramming
services.detail: Complimentary monogramming on eligible L.L.Bean items when purchased with this card.

services.name: Birthday bonus
services.detail: Cardholders get a birthday bonus; Citi doesn't state the amount.

services.name: 15% off Outdoor Discovery Programs
services.detail: A discount on L.L.Bean's outdoor classes and programs.

services.name: Special sales and exclusive offers
services.detail: Cardholder-only sales and offers from L.L.Bean.

services.name: Outdoor Impact Votes
services.detail: One vote per eligible purchase (not on the day you're approved), cast during a yearly window to direct L.L.Bean's support for outdoor organizations.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's L.L.Bean spend toward the 5% rate and shared shipping perks.

timeline.text: By August 2026 the L.L.Bean rate had gone up from 4% to 5% in Bean Bucks. Restaurants still earn 2% and everything else 1%.

Unlike Macy's, Bloomingdale's, or Wayfair, L.L.Bean does not appear to offer a separate closed-loop, store-only card; this open-loop Mastercard from Citi is the sole L.L.Bean-branded credit card product found.
